vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-113654
vulnerability.description: sanitize-html: HTML sanitization bypass via improper noscript tag handling

statements.impact_statement: Bumped sanitize-html in backend/package.json from ^2.17.7 to ^2.18.0 to pick up the upstream fix (installed 2.18.1 via npm install). Only usage is backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:54 (sanitizeRichText), which runs on author-written lesson HTML. Verified: backend unit suite 678/678 passing (22 suites), rich-text sanitiser suite 52/52 passing, lint clean, backend typecheck clean, full build successful.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-113661
vulnerability.description: sanitize-html: Cross-site scripting via unsafe meta refresh content attributes

statements.impact_statement: Closed by the same sanitize-html bump as CVE-2026-113654 — both CVEs are fixed in the 2.18.0 release and this PR installs 2.18.1 via package-lock refresh. Only call site is backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:54; <meta> is not in ALLOWED_TAGS, but the upstream fix hardens handling regardless. Verified: backend unit suite 678/678 passing, rich-text suite 52/52 passing, lint clean, backend typecheck clean, full build successful.
